note: Season f is real compact support of integral one, Reservation X f c is c = 1 on a ball with the complement spacelike to supp m for times in supp f, and Charge is the sum over b of the continued stress at (4,b) tested on K^b(c tensor f). Since partialProbe is minus the derivative, the right-hand side of action matches [M]'s signs; the identity is stated on the common word domain.

def Generates (Q : Wightman S) (T : S.Stress) (R : S.Rotation) := ∀ (X : Set E4), IsCompact X →
  ∀ (f : Probe ℝ), Season f → ∀ c, Reservation X f c → ∀ B : S.Tag, ∀ m : Test4, tsupport m ⊆ X →
  ∀ K : Killing, adjAction (Q:=Q) (Charge Q K T f c) (Q.operators.field (S.pin B.1 B.2) m) = action Q K R B m

lemma force {f : Extraction.Order} {F : Final C f S} (L : Almanac F) (p : F.α.space.X) :
    Force S (F.α.ensemble p) (L.contours p) F.sector.turns F.sector.derivatives F.room.kernel.spin (L.actors p) F.sector.energy := by

theorem local_action (K : Killing) (T : S.Stress) (B : S.Tag) (R : S.Rotation) (w : Prospect F Z U P H T)
    (h : StressLaws U T P.deriv R.lie) (ha : Gallery W Z) (hQ : FieldCore W R H Q)
    (m : Test4) {X : Set E4} (hX : IsCompact X) (hm : tsupport m ⊆ X)
    (f : Probe ℝ) (hf : Season f) (c : Probe Space3) (hc : Reservation X f c) :
    adjAction (Q:=Q) (Charge Q K T f c) (Q.operators.field (S.pin B.1 B.2) m) = action Q K R B m := by
